claim_boundary: Finite exact index and window-increment comparison from the depth-three 2-valuation chain to a discrete moving-seam response port. It does not provide arithmetic quadrature of the continuous theta window or archimedean completion.
index_map: e_(2^k) maps to valuation k and seam position L_k=k log 2

disposition.comparison_cone_extension: extends the selected prime-two valuation chain to the discrete seam-response port
disposition.remaining_gate: source-derived quadrature/incidence from prime-power samples L=k log p to the continuous window variation, including archimedean remainder
